text_block_list.text: On a certain day as the leaves grew red —

……I found myself pondering at Stay 
Gold's demeanor from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …………She's too fast…………

…Up until now, I believe this is the first 
time I've seen her look so tense.

In other words, it's a reaction quite 
unlike her ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You're furrowing your brows pretty 
hard there eh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo.

For Stay Gold herself to be the one finding 
me for once is extremely rare. Something 
must've happened, and upon asking —

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's next race, could you find 
out what it is?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …I'm just a little curious, that's all.

Upon checking the records, Silence 
Suzuka has submitted her entry for 
her next race to be the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The Mainichi Okan huh ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……Haha, you knew just the words to say huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'll be taking that offer of yours. 
Let me run in the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this way, I'll be able to see it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Beats me. That's what I'm trying 
to find out as well.
It's the day of the Mainichi Okan ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Now then. Wonder how this 1800 
metre run is gonna turn out.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Still, this is the thrill of a journey ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(This sensation piercing through me… 
it could only be ———)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ————Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Can't hear me at all huh. 
……She's completely in the zone.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……Suzuka. Just where are you right now?
